Remove changes from the diff when they only implemented the now-rejected variance direction.

Replace the Object/Object extractor regression case with appropriately typed NettyRequest/HttpResponse coverage that still verifies server-side custom extraction, default-extractor ordering, and the request-view conversion path. Do not preserve a test that asserts the rejected broad-extractor API. Compile the Java HTTP Client usage tests against its now-invariant signature, and update directly affected callers if needed.

threads.body: [Testing] Neither `Netty41ServerTest` nor `NettyServerHeaderSelectorTest` registers a custom extractor, so existing server tests do not exercise this new hook or its request/response adaptation. Please add a library integration test that registers an extractor through this method, handles an HTTP request, and asserts request-derived `onStart` and response-derived `onEnd` attributes on the exported server span. Use the public `NettyRequest` getters; overriding a default attribute can also verify the documented extractor ordering.

[General] Please also document the Java HTTP Client source-compatibility break here. In the published `opentelemetry-java-http-client` API, the invariant signature rejects previously accepted extractors such as `AttributesExtractor<Object, Object>`. `CONTRIBUTING.md` requires a changelog entry for breaking API changes; the migration is currently described only in the PR description.

The preceding test-removal coding session 7761d5c6-5845-4099-bfa5-cc6b433031e3 ended at 2026-10-22T04:22:41Z. Its delivery was verified at f8dddff2a686e421f2aa147b4b4f4254fc18fe47. I downloaded the deterministic fix_ci.py 20830 --download-only bundle for Actions run 39721679203. The remaining build/test/smoke/example failures share a missing io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.servlet.common.javax.JavaxServletAccessor on downstream javaagent compile classpaths. Representative build job 119636623458 fails at Tomcat7Singletons.java:21; smoke job 119636623743 fails at Jetty8Singletons.java:33/36 and LibertySingletons.java:28/31. The generic inference errors at those sites are consequences of the missing superclass, not the invariant extractor APIs. Example log: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/actions/runs/39721679203/job/119636623743 .

Servlet3Accessor extends JavaxServletAccessor. The first correction added an implementation dependency on servlet-common-javax:library to servlet-3.0:javaagent, which fixes that project's compilation but does not expose the superclass to downstream javaagent modules. Jetty 8.0, Tomcat 7.0, and Liberty 20.0 all depend on servlet-3.0:javaagent and use Servlet3Accessor. Fix this compile-classpath wiring comprehensively with the smallest appropriate Gradle change. Consider making the helper an api dependency of the non-published servlet-3.0 javaagent module if that is the correct shared javaagent dependency boundary; alternatively use explicit dependencies in the actual downstream consumers following repository patterns. Keep servlet-3.0:library's helper dependency as implementation so library consumers do not regain the internal helper on their compile classpaths. Do not change production behavior or restore the library api dependency.

The Java HTTP Client library now narrows addAttributesExtractor from AttributesExtractor<? super HttpRequest, ? super HttpResponse<?>> to AttributesExtractor<HttpRequest, HttpResponse<?>>. This is the explicit user-requested invariant direction, and it is source-breaking for users passing broader extractor types. Add a concise entry under Unreleased / Breaking changes to non-stable APIs covering this change. Keep the existing concise NettyRequest entry. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and run the repository's Markdown formatter for the changed file.

Preserve all settled preparation work: invariant extractor signatures across the 19 HTTP builders, the new invariant Netty server customization method, final opaque NettyRequest with unchanged accessors and nullable captured remote address, and Ratpack's necessary checked exception. The new addsAttributesExtractor test has been removed at the user's request: do not restore or recreate it, and keep NettyServerHeaderSelectorTest absent from this PR's diff. Do not add naming changes, status customizers, new behavior, or unrelated fixes.

Apply narrow relevant formatting, then validate affected compilation for servlet-3.0:javaagent, jetty-8.0:javaagent, tomcat-7.0:javaagent, and liberty-20.0:javaagent together. Verify the Servlet library's public consumer compile/runtime dependency boundary remains as requested. Report exact validation and genuine blockers. Do not alter the invariant API direction to make tests pass.
